description: Read-only. Discover the right real-estate benchmark parameter by name fragment or group and return each parameter's `code`, English name, `dataType` (decimal/boolean/enum/date) and — for enum parameters — its `enumValues` legal-value domain. Use this to resolve the `parameterCode` you pass to `fastighetsbenchmark_get_comp_timeseries`, and read `dataType` to know which CompDatum value member to trust. Example: nameContains 'Total return'. Shared reference data; read-only — never writes.

group.description: Parameter group name to filter by, e.g. 'Return'.

lang.description: Language for names/descriptions; English default, 'sv' for Swedish.

pageSize.description: Rows per page (v2 default 50, max 500), e.g. 50.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

name: fastighetsbenchmark_find_parameter

code.description: CompParameter code; pass as parameterCode to fastighetsbenchmark_get_comp_timeseries, e.g. 'NX71'.

dataType.description: Which CompDatum value member this parameter produces (decimal/boolean/enum/date).

enumValues.description: For enum (E-prefixed) parameters: the full legal-value domain; absent for non-enum parameters.

groupName.description: Group the parameter belongs to, e.g. 'Return'.

isBaseData.description: True if manually entered base data; false if formula-derived (calculated).

unit.description: Unit of the value, e.g. '%' or 'SEK/m²'.

pageSize.description: Rows per page echoed back by v2, e.g. 50.

totalCount.description: Total matching rows across all pages; null/absent when count is skipped.

totalPages.description: Total page count; null/absent when count is skipped.

title: Find a Fastighetsbenchmark parameter
